name: AMC Theater Experience
description: A cinema-style preroll with automatic upcoming-movie trailer discovery through TMDB and YouTube metadata.

settings.label: 2026 AMC pre-roll video URL
settings.hint: Direct MP4 or HLS URL for slot 1. Use media you have permission to use.

settings.label: Trailer discovery mode
settings.hint: Use tmdb for automatic discovery, or feed to use only your custom JSON feed.

settings.label: TMDB API key
settings.hint: Required for automatic upcoming-movie and trailer discovery. Use your own TMDB API key.

settings.label: Upcoming movie release region
settings.hint: Two-letter region code. Defaults to US for the AMC-style lineup.

settings.label: Trailer language
settings.hint: TMDB language code such as en-US or pt-BR. Defaults to en-US.

settings.label: Upcoming release window (days)
settings.hint: Search upcoming movie releases from today through this many days (7–180; default 90).

settings.label: Fallback upcoming trailers feed URL
settings.hint: Optional JSON feed with up to eight direct-playable URLs. Used if TMDB discovery is unavailable or returns no trailers, unless mode is feed.

settings.label: Dolby at AMC intro video URL
